اغتربتن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَرَبْتُنَّ (iḡtarabtunna) /iɣ.ta.rab.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# اُغْتُرِبْتُنَّ (uḡturibtunna) /uɣ.tu.rib.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
